parameters.query:
select ticker, max(date_diff) as days_ago from (
select eu.*
, f.latest_filing
, f.latest_period
, case when f.latest_filing is null then eu.report_date - f.latest_period 
else eu.report_date - f.latest_filing 
	end as date_diff 
from earnings_upcoming eu 
left join (
	select ticker, max(period_end) as latest_period, max(filing_date) as latest_filing
	from fundamentals_facts ff
	group by ticker) as f on f.ticker = eu.ticker
--where eu.ticker = 'TUYA'
where eu.period_end != f.latest_period
and eu.report_date <= current_date - interval '1 days'
AND EXISTS (
                         SELECT 1 FROM universe u
                         WHERE u.ticker = eu.ticker
                         and u.industry != 'Shell Companies') 
and case when f.latest_filing is null then eu.report_date - f.latest_period 
else eu.report_date - f.latest_filing 
	end >0) as summary
group by summary.ticker
--having summary.ticker = 'A'
order by ticker asc;

SELECT ticker,
       CURRENT_DATE - '2011-01-01'::date AS days_ago,
  'US' as exchange -- US for stocks INDX for t-bills/commodities etc
FROM universe
  where ticker in ('TNX','FVX','TYX','BCOMCLTR','BCOMCO','IRX')
  and ipo_date <= '2018-01-01' --stocks only;

INSERT INTO public.universe AS u (
    ticker, name, exchange, currency, isin, type,
    sector, industry, gic_sector, gic_group, gic_industry, gic_sub_industry,
    country, ipo_date, cik, is_delisted,
    fiscal_year_end_month, fiscal_year_end_day, fiscal_year_end_date, fiscal_year_end_raw,
    latest_period_end, most_recent_quarter,
    fundamentals_run_id, fundamentals_source, fundamentals_last_seen
)
SELECT
    c.ticker, c.name, c.exchange, COALESCE(c.currency, 'USD'), c.isin, c.security_type,
    c.sector, c.industry, c.gic_sector, c.gic_group, c.gic_industry, c.gic_sub_industry,
    c.country, c.ipo_date, c.cik, COALESCE(c.is_delisted, false),
    c.fiscal_year_end_month, c.fiscal_year_end_day, c.fiscal_year_end_date, c.fiscal_year_end_raw,
    c.latest_period_end, c.most_recent_quarter,
    c.run_id, c.source, c.last_seen
FROM json_to_recordset($1::json) AS c(
    ticker text, name text, exchange text, currency text, isin text, security_type text,
    sector text, industry text,
    gic_sector text, gic_group text, gic_industry text, gic_sub_industry text,
    country text, ipo_date date, cik text, is_delisted boolean,
    fiscal_year_end_month smallint, fiscal_year_end_day smallint,
    fiscal_year_end_date date, fiscal_year_end_raw text,
    latest_period_end date, most_recent_quarter date,
    run_id text, source text, last_seen timestamptz
)
WHERE c.ticker IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (ticker) DO UPDATE SET
    name                   = EXCLUDED.name,
    exchange               = EXCLUDED.exchange,
    currency               = EXCLUDED.currency,
    isin                   = EXCLUDED.isin,
    type                   = EXCLUDED.type,
    sector                 = EXCLUDED.sector,
    industry               = EXCLUDED.industry,
    gic_sector             = EXCLUDED.gic_sector,
    gic_group              = EXCLUDED.gic_group,
    gic_industry           = EXCLUDED.gic_industry,
    gic_sub_industry       = EXCLUDED.gic_sub_industry,
    country                = EXCLUDED.country,
    ipo_date               = EXCLUDED.ipo_date,
    cik                    = EXCLUDED.cik,
    is_delisted            = EXCLUDED.is_delisted,
    fiscal_year_end_month  = EXCLUDED.fiscal_year_end_month,
    fiscal_year_end_day    = EXCLUDED.fiscal_year_end_day,
    fiscal_year_end_date   = EXCLUDED.fiscal_year_end_date,
    fiscal_year_end_raw    = EXCLUDED.fiscal_year_end_raw,
    latest_period_end      = EXCLUDED.latest_period_end,
    most_recent_quarter    = EXCLUDED.most_recent_quarter,
    fundamentals_run_id    = EXCLUDED.fundamentals_run_id,
    fundamentals_source    = EXCLUDED.fundamentals_source,
    fundamentals_last_seen = EXCLUDED.fundamentals_last_seen,
    updated_at             = now();

INSERT INTO fundamentals_quality_flags
    (ticker, "check", period_end, severity, value_num, detail, as_of, run_id, source)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (ticker, "check", period_end)
       q.ticker, q.check, COALESCE(q.period_end, '0001-01-01'::date),
       q.severity, q.value_num, q.detail, q.as_of, q.run_id, q.source
FROM json_to_recordset($1::json) AS q(
    ticker text, "check" text, period_end date, severity text,
    value_num numeric, detail text, as_of timestamptz,
    run_id text, source text
)
ORDER BY ticker, "check", period_end, abs(q.value_num) DESC NULLS LAST
ON CONFLICT (ticker, "check", period_end) DO UPDATE SET
    severity  = EXCLUDED.severity,
    value_num = EXCLUDED.value_num,
    detail    = EXCLUDED.detail,
    as_of     = EXCLUDED.as_of,
    run_id    = EXCLUDED.run_id;

INSERT INTO fundamentals_facts
    (ticker, statement, frequency, period_end, attribute,
     value_num, value_text, filing_date, currency, as_of, run_id, source)
SELECT f.ticker, f.statement, f.frequency, f.period_end, f.attribute,
       f.value_num, f.value_text, f.filing_date, f.currency,
       f.as_of, f.run_id, f.source
FROM json_to_recordset($1::json) AS f(
    ticker text, statement text, frequency text, period_end date,
    attribute text, value_num numeric, value_text text,
    filing_date date, currency text, as_of timestamptz,
    run_id text, source text
)
ON CONFLICT (ticker, statement, frequency, period_end, attribute) DO UPDATE SET
    value_num   = EXCLUDED.value_num,
    value_text  = EXCLUDED.value_text,
    filing_date = EXCLUDED.filing_date,
    currency    = EXCLUDED.currency,
    as_of       = EXCLUDED.as_of,
    run_id      = EXCLUDED.run_id;

INSERT INTO market_stats
    (ticker, beta, shares_outstanding, shares_float, shares_short,
     shares_short_prior_month, short_ratio, short_percent_float,
     percent_insiders, percent_institutions, wall_street_target, as_of)
SELECT s.ticker, s.beta, s.shares_outstanding, s.shares_float, s.shares_short,
       s.shares_short_prior_month, s.short_ratio, s.short_percent_float,
       s.percent_insiders, s.percent_institutions, s.wall_street_target, s.as_of
FROM json_to_recordset($1::json) AS s(
    ticker text, beta numeric, shares_outstanding numeric, shares_float numeric,
    shares_short numeric, shares_short_prior_month numeric, short_ratio numeric,
    short_percent_float numeric, percent_insiders numeric, percent_institutions numeric,
    wall_street_target numeric, as_of timestamptz
)
ON CONFLICT (ticker) DO UPDATE SET
    beta                     = EXCLUDED.beta,
    shares_outstanding       = EXCLUDED.shares_outstanding,
    shares_float             = EXCLUDED.shares_float,
    shares_short             = EXCLUDED.shares_short,
    shares_short_prior_month = EXCLUDED.shares_short_prior_month,
    short_ratio              = EXCLUDED.short_ratio,
    short_percent_float      = EXCLUDED.short_percent_float,
    percent_insiders         = EXCLUDED.percent_insiders,
    percent_institutions     = EXCLUDED.percent_institutions,
    wall_street_target       = EXCLUDED.wall_street_target,
    as_of                    = EXCLUDED.as_of,
    updated_at               = now();

INSERT INTO earnings_calendar
    (ticker, report_date, period_end, before_after_market, currency,
     actual, estimate, difference, surprise_pct, source)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (e.ticker, e.report_date)
       e.ticker, e.report_date, e.period_end, e.before_after_market, e.currency,
       e.actual, e.estimate, e.difference, e.surprise_pct, e.source
FROM json_to_recordset($1::json) AS e(
    ticker text, report_date date, period_end date, before_after_market text,
    currency text, actual numeric, estimate numeric, difference numeric,
    surprise_pct numeric, source text
)
WHERE e.ticker IS NOT NULL AND e.report_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY e.ticker, e.report_date, e.actual NULLS LAST
ON CONFLICT (ticker, report_date) DO UPDATE SET
    period_end          = EXCLUDED.period_end,
    before_after_market = EXCLUDED.before_after_market,
    currency            = EXCLUDED.currency,
    actual              = EXCLUDED.actual,
    estimate            = EXCLUDED.estimate,
    difference          = EXCLUDED.difference,
    surprise_pct        = EXCLUDED.surprise_pct,
    updated_at          = now();

-- Tickers still needing a fundamentals backfill, after run 100608 stalled at 02:28 on
-- 2026-09-26 (n8n RangeError: Invalid string length -- V8's max string size hit while
-- serialising the accumulated payload to the JS task runner, not an EODHD rejection).
--
-- BACKFILL WINDOW: 2007-01-01 -> 2021-12-31. The existing fundamentals all start at
-- 2021-12-31, so that date is both the end of the window and the marker of an untouched
-- ticker: "already done" means holding at least one quarterly fact dated BEFORE it.
-- A plain "has no facts" test would return almost nothing, because every ticker has facts
-- from 2021-12-31 onward.
--
-- Also requires PRICES inside the window. The ML panel is built per (ticker, month-end) from
-- daily_prices, so fundamentals with no prices to join to buy nothing and cost API credits.
--
-- Ordered so an interruption leaves the useful names done: open positions, then the
-- watchlist, then deepest price history (the long panel's whole point), then liquidity.

with params as (
  select date '2007-01-01' as window_start,
         date '2021-12-31' as window_end        -- where the existing fundamentals begin
),
have as (                                        -- earliest fact per ticker, one pass
  select ticker, min(period_end) as earliest_fact, count(*) as fact_rows
  from fundamentals_facts
  group by ticker
),
px as (                                          -- price coverage, one pass
  select ticker, min(date) as first_price, max(date) as last_price, count(*) as price_rows
  from daily_prices
  group by ticker
),
held as (select distinct ticker from trade_log where lower(status) = 'open'),
watch as (select distinct ticker from pivot_watch)
select u.ticker,
       u.exchange,
       h.earliest_fact,
       coalesce(h.fact_rows, 0)                  as fact_rows_held,
       p.first_price,
       coalesce(p.price_rows, 0)                 as price_rows,
       greatest(p.first_price, pa.window_start)  as fetch_from,   -- no point asking for
       pa.window_end                             as fetch_to,     -- years with no prices
       case when held.ticker  is not null then 'open position'
            when watch.ticker is not null then 'on the watchlist'
            when p.first_price <= date '2014-12-31' then 'deep price history'
            else 'universe' end                  as priority_reason
from universe u
join      px    p    on p.ticker = u.ticker      -- no prices at all: nothing to join to
left join have  h    on h.ticker = u.ticker
left join held       on held.ticker = u.ticker
left join watch      on watch.ticker = u.ticker
cross join params pa
where u.type = 'Common Stock'
  and coalesce(u.is_delisted, false) = false
  -- untouched: no facts at all, or nothing older than where the existing data starts
  and (h.earliest_fact is null or h.earliest_fact >= pa.window_end)
  -- and it actually traded inside the window
  and p.first_price < pa.window_end
  --and u.ticker like '%-%'
order by
  (held.ticker  is not null) desc,
  (watch.ticker is not null) desc,
  p.first_price asc,
  p.price_rows desc,
  u.ticker;
select * from universe where ticker like '%-%'
